title: Implement Roman numeral conversion in Go
description: Implement ToRoman(n int) string and FromRoman(s string) int supporting values 1–3999.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement ToRoman and FromRoman in roman.go:
- `ToRoman`: use a lookup table of (value, symbol) pairs including subtractives: 1000/M, 900/CM, 500/D, 400/CD, 100/C, 90/XC, 50/L, 40/XL, 10/X, 9/IX, 5/V, 4/IV, 1/I; repeatedly subtract and append
- `FromRoman`: map each symbol to its value; if a symbol is less than the next, subtract it; otherwise add it
All 3 tests must pass (including the 1-100 round-trip).
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
